## Activity

During May 2024, Central Eye Clinic recorded 205 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The figure provides the operational basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes at the site. Activity should be considered alongside the number of images suitable for assessment and the results returned through grading.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed during May 2024, 7 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.4. This is the reported proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. The result should be monitored as part of routine site operations, with attention to maintaining clear and assessable images.

## Grading

Grading identified 58 referable results during the month. The median lag from capture to grading was 3. This indicates the typical interval reported for the service between image capture and completion of grading. Together, the activity, image-quality, and grading measures provide a summary of Central Eye Clinic performance for May 2024.
